linkInTextBlock.help: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
linkInTextBlock.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.1:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #b8470a, surrounding text: #5d6570)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
